name: Krispy Kreme Donut
assumptions: Yield estimated from standard Krispy Kreme-style yeast-raised donut recipes using similar total flour (5 cups) and producing ~1 dozen full-sized donuts plus holes.
Total time aggregates instruction steps: ~55 min first rise, ~35 min second rise, ~10 min mixing/rolling/cutting, ~20 min frying in batches, ~10 min glazing; rounded conservatively.
Flour measurement corrected from erroneous '5 drops' to 5 cups per provided ingredient assumptions and standard recipes.
Oil measurement corrected from erroneous 'Sprinking' to deep-frying quantity with absorption estimate per provided assumptions.
Vanilla measurement corrected from erroneous '1 1/2 cups' to 1.5 tsp per provided assumptions.
No tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, soy, or sesame in listed ingredients; ambiguous for possible cross-contact or unspecified 'shortening' variants hence null.
All classifications based strictly on explicitly listed ingredients without assuming unlisted items or substitutions.
instructions:
Dissolve yeast in warm water in 2 1/2-quart bowl. Add milk, sugar, salt, eggs, shortening and 2 cups flour. Beat on low for 30 seconds, scraping bowl constantly. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in remaining flour until smooth. Cover and let rise until double, 50-60 minutes. (Dough is ready when indentation remains when touched.) Turn dough onto floured surface; roll around lightly to coat with flour. Gently roll dough 1/2-inch thick with floured rolling pin. Cut with floured doughnut cutter. Cover and let rise until double, 30-40 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in deep fryer to 350°. Slide doughnuts into hot oil with wide spatula. Turn doughnuts as they rise to the surface. Fry until golden brown, about 1 minute on each side. Remove carefully from oil (do not prick surface); drain. Dip the doughnuts into creamy glaze set on rack.


Glaze: 
Heat butter until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth. Stir in water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until desired consistency.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Granulated white sugar; 1/2 cup = 100g standard measure.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.assumptions: Large whole eggs; 2 eggs ≈ 100g edible portion.

ingredients.name: Flour
ingredients.assumptions: All-purpose flour; measurement listed as '5 drops' is clearly erroneous (likely OCR/copy-paste error from glaze section); assumed 5 cups based on standard Krispy Kreme-style yeast donut recipes that use ~5-5.25 cups total flour to match the rise, beating and rolling instructions; ~650g total.

ingredients.name: Canola Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Canola oil for deep frying; 'Sprinking' is erroneous/vague; plausible assumption of ~40g absorbed oil per batch of ~12 donuts based on typical fried donut absorption rates (recipe context implies enough for deep fryer at 350°F).

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Whole milk; 1/2 cup = 120 ml/g standard measure (listed out of order but used in dough).

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Powdered sugar for glaze; 2 cups = 200g standard measure (listed out of order).

ingredients.name: Vanilla
ingredients.assumptions: Vanilla extract; 1 1/2 tsp assumed (measurement listed as 1 1/2 cups is clearly erroneous given context and typical glaze recipes; 1.5 tsp ≈ 6-7g but using 15g to reflect plausible total liquid); negligible impact but estimated.

ingredients.name: Boiling Water
ingredients.assumptions: Boiling water for glaze; 6 tablespoons = 90 ml assumed density 1g/ml.
